title: EVOL/AUD plain-PASS rows drop the stage-level PASS_SCOPED marker and carry no SHA or audit pointer in the checklist row
affected_invariant: Checklist PASS evidence rule (L36-L50): exact SHA plus independent audit evidence per FRZ PASS
impact: Eleven rows read as unscoped PASS in the checklist while the independent audit and certifier verdicts are PASS_SCOPED (AUTOMATION_FIRST_SCOPED qualification layer; OPEN-BP-01, F-W3-001, Path B) and the row itself has no 40-hex SHA. The evidence exists and checks out in the IIAC records, so the PASS is substantively supported; only traceability from the row is weak and a reader of the checklist alone overstates scope. Note: the OD-ENT-08 record itself says FRZ-AUD-01..09 PASS, so the plain wording is operator-sanctioned.
recommendation: Add the exact audit/closure SHA and a SCOPED marker (or a pointer to the IIAC verdict record) to these rows at the next checklist maintenance; no status change.
decision_authority: Operator (checklist owner); IIAC protocol decides certification semantics

title: ENT-AUDIT-X and EVOL-X PASS evidence is bound to TES SHAs; product code changed materially afterwards and the ENT-AUDIT-X audit code itself was edited after the activation pin
affected_invariant: Roadmap invariants 22-23 (ARCH-FREEZE entry: freeze-SHA enterprise audit PASS); FRZ-FRZ-12
impact: Observed with git diff only (nothing re-run): between TES 3c4a641b and BASELINE about 240 files / 23k insertions changed under intergrax, agents, applications; between ENT-AUDIT-X TES prime 32a96334 and BASELINE enterprise_audit/impact_map.py and changed_since_impact_map.v1.json gained about 505 lines in three commits (df136ef85, b12832cc0, 584c84168); only 584c84168 post-dates the current activation audit_execution_sha a1b3053b. EVOL-X qualification code (testing_support/change_safety, tests/qualification/evol_x) is unchanged since TES. The 85-check FREEZE PASS and the EVOL graph-coverage measurement therefore describe the TES trees, not BASELINE. This is expected before freeze and is covered by FRZ-FRZ-12 (OPEN), but the checklist rows read as current PASS.
recommendation: Treat these PASS rows as historical-at-TES until a certifying FREEZE audit and EVOL graph-coverage re-measurement run on the freeze SHA; confirm whether 584c84168 needs an IIAC re-pin.

title: Accepted scoped limitations behind PASS rows: no live branch protection (FRZ-AUD-10), qualification-layer-only deploy/rollback (FRZ-EVOL-07), sample-based selection evidence (FRZ-EVOL-06)
impact: Each limitation is explicitly recorded, operator-accepted and carried in the row text. FRZ-AUD-10 relies on a compensating control (enterprise-audit workflows exist) with live branch protection of development unresolved; FRZ-EVOL-07 does not claim production ActivationService.rollback durable-state enforcement; FRZ-EVOL-06 zero-under-selection evidence is a 56-path sample and M-03 shows consistency, not discrimination.
recommendation: Keep the limitations visible in the ARCH-FREEZE handoff; decide at freeze whether OPEN-BP-01 must be live or may remain compensating.
